timeout_seconds.description: Decision timeout in seconds — auto-deny on expiry.

trust_ttl_seconds.description: Trust grant lifetime in seconds. 0 = disabled (default).

catalogue_path.description: Path to the model catalogue (catalogue.toml). Defaults to the in-repo file alongside the controller code.

model_search_dirs.description: Ordered list of directories the ModelRegistry searches for installed GGUF files. First match wins.

mcpd_binary.description: Path to the mcpd binary (relative to repo root or absolute).

audit_log.description: Path to the append-only audit log (INV-8). Supports ~/ expansion.

pb_endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint for the Privileged Brain llama-server.

pb_model_id.description: Model ID for PB (used in audit rows).

mcpd_schemas_dir.description: Directory containing mcpd tool JSON schemas. Empty = auto-detect from mcpd_binary.

session.description: REPL session and UX parameters. All optional.

max_turns.description: Maximum turns before session auto-closes (P2-F20 memory bound).

history_path.description: Path to readline history file. Supports ~/ expansion.

show_spinner.description: Show live braille spinner while QB/PB/mcpd process.

show_progress.description: Show step-by-step pipeline progress instead of generic spinner.

stream_output.description: Stream QB summarisation tokens as they arrive.

color.description: ANSI colour output. 'auto' enables when stdout is a TTY.

prompt_prefix.description: Prefix shown in the REPL prompt: `(N) [backend] prefix > `.

max_tool_output_lines.description: Lines of tool output forwarded to QB for summarisation.

keymap.description: HITL approval-gate key bindings. All optional — defaults to numeric + mnemonic + universal bindings. Each value is an array of single-character strings.

deny.description: Keys that trigger DENY. Default: ["2", "d", "n"]. Esc is always DENY regardless.

trust.description: Keys that trigger TRUST. Default: ["5", "t"]. Disabled when trust_ttl_seconds = 0.

help.description: Keys that trigger HELP. Default: ["?"]. '?' must always be included.

undo.description: Undo scaffold — BP-2 off by default. Awaits mcpd rollback RPC.

enabled.description: Enable undo history tracking and /undo REPL command.

max_history.description: Ring buffer depth for undo history per session.

verifier.description: QB-verifier voting. Default votes=1 preserves current single-call behavior (BP-2).

votes.description: Number of independent QB verification calls. 1 = current behavior.

require.description: Exact threshold of 'verified: true' votes required. 0 = majority (ceil(votes/2)).

parallel.description: Run votes in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor. Default true.

prompts.description: System prompt file locations. All optional — defaults to the in-package controller/prompts/ directory.

prompts_dir.description: Directory containing prompt .txt files. Empty = in-package default. Phase 6: set to /etc/icebreaker/prompts.

qb_local.description: Override path for qb_local.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_anthropic.description: Override path for qb_anthropic.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_gemini.description: Override path for qb_gemini.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_openai.description: Override path for qb_openai.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

pb.description: Override path for pb.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_verifier.description: Override path for qb_verifier.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

model_id.description: Catalogue key (looked up in catalogue.toml). The Controller never sees the on-disk filename — resolved via the model registry.

draft_model_id.description: Optional speculative-decoding draft. Must reference a catalogue entry with role='draft'.

transport.description: Transport for llama-server. 'http' today; 'unix' reserved for Phase 6 distro packaging.
